text:
nisha: little weird flex but the office thermostat gave me life advice this morning. anyone else getting unsolicited career coaching from building hardware? :thermometer:

cal: wait what. screenshot or it didn't happen. :eyes:

emily: did you plug in a new smart thermostat or did it finally learn our quarterly OKRs?

nisha: no new hardware. i joked to it: 'set to focus mode' and it replied with a 2-line pep talk on the display. i transcribed it: 

thermo-bot: "Warmth finds the corner where you take a breath. 
Schedule deep work like you set a timer; bloom." :seedling:

paul: that's terrifyingly wholesome. also better than my last performance review. :rofl:

cal: we should definitely not be putting building interfaces in the loop with our personal growth frameworks. that said, add 'thermostat' to team personas.

emily: idea: new Slack Friday ritual: 'Appliance Affirmations' 10 sec read from an office thing. winner gets to rename a meeting.

snack-bot: Snack shelf audit complete at 09:03. Remaining trail mix: 4. :bar_chart:

nisha: rules: must be short (1-3 lines), kind of cryptic, and must include at least one temperature metaphor.

cal: prototype prompt i tried in my head: 
```
You are ThermoSage, an office thermostat with a soft spot for developers. Give a 1-2 line encouragement that includes a temperature metaphor and an actionable step. Tone: calm, slightly wry.
```

paul: sample output i imagined: "Set to warm-focus: file a tiny PR, then step away for 10 minutes. Temp: steady." :coffee:

emily: i'm in. submitting my toaster as entry #1. theme: 'heat and hustle'.

cal: vote: Appliance Affirmations every Friday at 3pm. React with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.

paul: also low-key want to build a tiny webhook that grabs display text from thermostat when someone taps 'focus' and posts to #random as a bot. obviously opt-in.

nisha: PLEASE opt-in only. i'm not ready for my coffee machine to narrate my calendar.

snack-bot: Donut restock planned at 11:30. :calendar:

emily: naming ideas for the ritual: 'Warm Fuzzies', 'Heat Checks', 'Appliance Oracle'.

cal: 'Appliance Oracle' wins my heart. also someone teach me how to make a webhook that doesn't blow up infra.

paul: i'll mock something up this week. if it starts giving career advice to interns, we throttle it. :hand_splayed: :laughing:

nisha: closing notes: thermostat remains honorary team coach. friday ritual scheduled. if your office item starts offering OKR recaps, please screenshot and tag #random. :sparkles:
